   else = { country_event = { id = ctc_cp_CAN.10 days = 2 } }
 } } }

 is_triggered_only = yes
 desc = { trigger = { ctc_cp_can_administer = yes has_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_full } text = ctc_cp_CAN.13.d0 }
 desc = { trigger = { ctc_cp_can_administer = yes OR = { has_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_partial has_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_full } } text = ctc_cp_CAN.13.d1 }
 desc = ctc_cp_CAN.13.d2
 immediate = { set_country_flag = ctc_cp_event_open set_country_flag = ctc_cp_last_event }
 option = {
  name = ctc_cp_CAN.13.o0
  ai_chance = { factor = 100 }
  clr_country_flag = ctc_cp_event_open
custom_effect_tooltip = ctc_cp_settlement_tt
hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_settled add_political_power = 5
 if = { limit = { ctc_cp_can_administer = yes has_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_full } set_variable = { ctc_cp_delta = 2 }
 subtract_from_variable = { ctc_cp_delta = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_credit }
 clamp_variable = { var = ctc_cp_delta min = 0 max = 2 }
 add_to_variable = { ctc_cp_done_administration = ctc_cp_delta }
 set_variable = { ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_credit = 2 }
 ctc_cp_refresh = yes  }
 else_if = { limit = { ctc_cp_can_administer = yes OR = { has_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_partial has_country_flag = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_full } } set_variable = { ctc_cp_delta = 1 }
 subtract_from_variable = { ctc_cp_delta = ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_credit }
 clamp_variable = { var = ctc_cp_delta min = 0 max = 2 }
 add_to_variable = { ctc_cp_done_administration = ctc_cp_delta }
 set_variable = { ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_credit = 1 }
 ctc_cp_refresh = yes set_country_flag = ctc_cp_arrears }
 else = { set_variable = { ctc_cp_CAN_common_1_administration_1_credit = 0 } set_country_flag = ctc_cp_arrears } }
 }
}
